title: Doses of insulins
symptom: User wants to know how to enter doses of fast and slow insulins in xDrip+, because when clicking the syringe icon there is no distinction between the two types; only one kind of insulin can be entered.
cause: The thread indicates that the feature to distinguish basal and bolus insulin was never added, and there is no way to directly attach a note to the injection.
fix: The capability to use multiple insulin types exists. Go to Settings -> xDrip+ Predictive Simulation -> Multiple Insulin Types.
evidence_quote: The capability to use multiple insulin types exists. Please see Settings -> xDrip+ Predictive Simulation -> Multiple Insulin Types
